content: NN/G (2014): static indicators ("Loading...") are the worst option because they convey no progress and look identical to a hang; looped spinners suit 2-10s waits, determinate feedback 10s+. Percent-done sets a speed expectation, so stalls/resets at the end destroy satisfaction; the guidance is to start slowly, allow extra time (finishing early is a pleasant surprise), and prefer step counts when totals are uncertain. UX Tigers (2026) restates it: never let a progress indicator stall, lie, or reset.
